suspicion: Iteration reset could mix identities (e.g. RandomStream::reset after reset_for_iteration replays the old identity, or Engine derives a chunk-local iteration)
why_rejected: RandomStream stores root_seed/global_iteration and reset() re-derives from them (random.rs:79-85); reset_for_iteration replaces the whole stream with identity.stream() (state.rs:447-451); Engine forwards the host identity unchanged (engine/src/lib.rs:856-859) and owns no other RNG or rotation state (RotationState is pure scratch, rotation/src/execution.rs:304-309).
